title: FREE REQUEST Spriter contribution for RPG MAKER VX ACE project.

posts.author: Hyperion_Oblivion
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
I wanted to ask for help for a single thing.
I have an In-development project, called: "Digital World: Network."
The game has 4 protagonists, I have the designs (In Gacha Life 2 Base, cuz I don't know how to draw pre-teens.)
I would like if someone helped me out and made me the spritesheets for them, please.
I just would need the following:
(Be quite similar to the RPM MV "Chibi" Style)
- 4 direction sprite.
- 1 Variation of damaged sprite.
Those are the "Designs":
For me, the designs are simple. But I you wanna contribute, you can make your own personal changes. I will thank
ANY
contribution. Thanks and have a good day!

posts.author: Myuqi
posts.body: I am a sprite artist, these are sprites I made for my own personal project of characters, if you like it you can dm me on discord my username is Myuqiqi
